name: Obby But You Have Bones
desc:
[Alpha Version 0.1]
Welcome to Obby But You Have Bones! 

🩻 Break bones in X-ray view!
🤣 Play with ragdoll physics!
🪙 Earn coins to buy fun toys & tools!
👑 Make it to the end of the obby before time runs out!

🪲Report any bugs on the group wall🪲
👍Leave a thumbs up & favorite the game!👍
